correctness.rationale: For any field and r>=1 the matrix equations are exactly a_0 b_0=0, a_i b_i=0, a_0 beta_i+alpha_i b_i=0. The a_0=0 slice is the union of explicit linear Z_T; the a_0!=0 slice consists of 2^r irreducible branches. Each proposed X_S is a height-s complete intersection with irreducible dimension-(1+2s) open x!=0 and boundary dimension 2s, so unmixedness prohibits extra boundary components. Distinguishing dense-open witnesses prove all proposed irreducible pieces are genuine components. Disjoint stratification yields both the Grothendieck class and exact polynomial finite-field counts. Direct dense-matrix verification passed in nine field/size cases including F4. The argument addresses reduced geometry, not nonreduced schemes.

originality.rationale: The inspected radical-square-zero, zero-product-determined and annihilating-nilpotent-matrix literature does not establish the one-sided star incidence algebra component classification, motivic class or finite-field point polynomial. The closest open star-poset result concerns interval-endomorphism global dimension rather than zero-product pairs. All searched near-equivalences were compared by defining conditions and implications, not titles. A plausible triangular-algebra article remained abstract-only, and unindexed results are a live priority risk; thus originality is a best-knowledge assessment, not a publication-priority certificate. A related earlier full-upper-triangular algebra result is compared explicitly: its unrestricted-factor annihilator enumerator and top-dimensional component statement do not determine the sparse star subalgebra locus or its lower-dimensional components.
residual_risks: Full text of Ghahramani (2013) was not inspected; an unexpected component census there cannot be excluded.

value.rationale: Zero-product pairs encode the multiplication relation in a natural incidence algebra family relevant to zero-product preserver questions. Determining the entire geometric decomposition (2^(r+1) components with a binomial dimension profile and systematic non-equidimensionality) jointly with an exact motivic class and a finite-field point count for all field extensions yields a natural complete arithmetic/geometric invariant. The exponential component proliferation is structural and is not an arbitrary small-parameter gain or a restatement of zero-product determinedness. A prior count for the full upper triangular algebra does not supply the component profile of the constrained star incidence subalgebra.
